profile.configuration: Existing synthetic Work composition, including its existing excluded shell behavior; no behavior changed to make the probe pass.

isolation: Private mount/PID/network namespace and private app/config/HOME/cache; no shared-preview mutations.
Same logical source paths preserve the real profile cache identity. Qualified environments and actual source trees are read-only.
Source-binding metadata and sibling lock directories are private writable copies; no histories, schedules or credentials copied.
Normal uv command uses --locked --no-sync, with offline mode and interpreter downloads disabled. Missing cache qualification is a failed prerequisite, never an installer fallback.

failedSetupAttemptsPreserved.failure: Whole Foundation bind made source-binding lock directory read-only
failedSetupAttemptsPreserved.resolution: Kept source trees immutable; separated private writable cache bookkeeping.

failedSetupAttemptsPreserved.failure: Probe selection used provider rather than the normal instance key
failedSetupAttemptsPreserved.resolution: Passed documented instance key with the already-mounted dev-synthetic identity.

limitations: Three finite starts are not a p95 or sustained-load qualification.
Existing profile/dependencies and filesystem caches are warm; this does not measure a fully cold installation or changed-composition requalification.
No browser input acknowledgment, model request, paid provider, external tool, or copied conversation was executed.

Timing wrappers observe actual methods. Spawn duration is subprocess creation only; total ready includes interpreter import, bundle load, activation and mounting. Phase measurements need not cover or sum to the total.
